subject: cult-info-b
title: CULT.INFO.B.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 141 (AE(PD)-29). CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: TRS (transition) and PART (participation), with the (D) prefix, "the dynamics of". From TRS: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From PART: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is on a dotted line from PART. From EXP-DY: RT-OP (reality options) and TF-SH (transfer shifts). From PHY-U-P: PROG-SIGN (progressional significance).
